summary: Iter 41 (part 2) — backend projection + Cache-Control + Mongo indexes + frontend in-memory cache + GA4 page_view/business events. All P0 criteria PASS. P1 cache + page_view PASS via Playwright SPA-nav test. Backend pytest 6/6 pass.
verified_features: P0 PROJECTION: POST /api/vehicles with 5x300KB base64 photos → GET /api/vehicles returns items WITHOUT photos[] but WITH cover_photo (server-extracted). Payload size drops from ~1.5MB (raw photos) to ~410KB (cover only) = 73% reduction on this test case; scales to 90%+ for multi-vehicle photo-heavy garages. Required fields present: id, make, model, year, mileage_current, cover_photo, active_listing, status, open_to_offers.
P0 CACHE-CONTROL: GET /api/vehicles at http://localhost:8001 returns 'Cache-Control: private, max-age=30, stale-while-revalidate=120'. (Ingress at preview URL strips it as expected.)

P0 INDEXES: Verified via motor list_indexes(): vehicles has user_id_1 + user_id_1_created_at_-1 + open_to_offers_1_searchable_1; service_entries has vehicle_id_1_date_-1; swap_listings has active_1_created_at_-1; swap_interactions has from_user_id_1_to_vehicle_id_1. Backend log confirms 'Iter 41 vehicles / service / swap indexes ensured.'
P0 SKELETON: /garage renders [data-testid='dashboard-page'] on mount; SkeletonGarageGrid displayed while filtered===null (Garage.js line 90-91). Untouched by Iter 41 changes.

P1 FRONTEND CACHE (in-memory): SPA nav /garage → /marketplace → /garage (via history.pushState+popstate) resulted in exactly 1 GET /api/vehicles call (only initial fetch; second garage mount served from cache). cacheHit confirmed.

P1 GA4 PAGE_VIEW: window.gtag mock via add_init_script captured 4 page_view events with correct paths across SPA nav (/garage, /garage [strict-mode double-invoke], /marketplace, /garage). Hook fires on every useLocation change.

P1 GA4 EVENTS (code review): trackEvent('login'/'sign_up'/'demo_start') in AuthContext.js verified via code; trackEvent('add_vehicle') in VehicleForm.js line 108-110; trackEvent('create_listing') in CreateListing.js; trackEvent('swap_interested') in SwapPage; trackEvent('open_to_offers') in VehicleProfile. All paths are correctly wired to the safe trackEvent wrapper (silent no-op if gtag absent).

REGRESSION: Iter 40 auth flow (POST /auth/demo returns token, GET /auth/me works, is_demo=True). Iter 39 endpoints intact (vehicles/stats, vehicles/open-to-offers). No console errors observed during navigation. Iter 41 infinite-loop fix confirmed in Iter 17 remains in place (no /marketplace/messages/threads runaway).
critical_code_review_comments: apiCache.js is clean: Map-based, module-scoped, single-flight via _inFlight, prefix-based cacheBust. Simple and correct.
usePageTracking.js safely handles missing gtag; trackEvent wrapper is idempotent — good.

Minor: /vehicles projection returns cover_photo as the FULL data URL for legacy base64 uploads (no thumb variant); for R2-backed uploads (dict photos with thumb_url), it correctly uses thumb. If most production users have base64 legacy photos, backend payload reduction is bounded by 1×cover_photo per vehicle — still a big win vs. all-photos, but consider a server-side base64→thumb transcode as future work.

Note: cacheBust after add_vehicle could not be verified end-to-end via UI (SPA nav to /garage/new via history API didn't hydrate VehicleForm in the test harness). Code path is correct by inspection — cacheBust('/vehicles') + trackEvent('add_vehicle') are both invoked synchronously in the submit success branch.

Note: In-memory cache is module-scoped so a full page reload (F5) resets it — expected & documented in apiCache.js comment. Browser HTTP cache (via Cache-Control header) covers that layer at origin, ingress permitting.
test_credentials: POST /api/auth/demo (fresh demo user per run, plan=premium, 0 vehicles).
seed_data_creation: Backend test creates one TEST_Toyota vehicle with 5x300KB dummy photos under fresh demo user (auto-expires with 24h demo TTL). No cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For SPA-nav cache tests use history.pushState + PopStateEvent (page.goto is a full reload that resets module-level in-memory cache — that's not a bug, that's by design). For GA4, add_init_script the mock BEFORE goto so window.gtag is defined on first render. Backend pytest suite in /app/backend/tests/test_iter41.py covers projection + Cache-Control + indexes + regression.
